text:
Nina Patel: Quick sync  want to confirm the social handoff for the webinar + benchmark deep-dive. Proposed: hero post + 2 follow-ups on X, LinkedIn carousel, gated PDF behind webinar sign-up.
Marco Diaz: Love it. For hero stat, let's use the operational metric not just cost: '50% lower average latency under load' + separate card for cost. Elena can craft the line.
Elena Kostova: I'll do variant copy. A: 'Lower latency. Lower cost. Same quality.' B: 'Ship faster experiences with 50% less latency.' Will run A on LinkedIn, B on X.
CreativeBot: Assets queued: hero-card, carousel, demo-gif. ETA: hero 4pm PT, GIF by tomorrow 10am.
SDR Ops: Routing note: high-touch lead (company_size > 200 OR requested demo) -> AE; mid-size -> SDR nurture; small -> content nurture. We'll post to #sales-leads with full metadata.
Nina Patel: Budget: $350 boost on X first 48h. Target: product managers & infra engs.
Marco Diaz: Engagement ops: reply to top 12 replies in first 3 hours, pin a summary, collect top 5 questions for the webinar FAQ.
Elena Kostova: For the PDF gating, we'll require email + company name + use-case. Add `utm_source=social&utm_campaign=benchmark_mar` to all links.
CreativeBot: Posting templates exported to #creative-assets: benchmark-hero-mar.png, carousel-01..04.png, demo-gif.mp4
Nina Patel: OK final checklist: Elena copy by 3pm, Creative assets by 4pm, SDR webhook and mapping done by GrowthOps. I'll schedule in Buffer once everything's in.
Marco Diaz: Dry run Tues 8am PT.
Nina Patel: Great. If any blockers, drop them here. :pray:
